author: Mark Atwood
text:
Escalating to human: same 0.2.0 epic family as JMAP-6r7c.36 / .50 / .48 / .26 / .31 / .59-followups. AuthProvider::auth_header signature reshape is a SemVer-breaking trait change that ripples to every implementor (in-workspace: BearerAuth, BasicAuth, NoneAuth, plus a Box/Arc blanket impl; out-of-workspace: any consumer that has implemented their own AuthProvider).

See JMAP-6r7c.36 comment for the umbrella-bundling recommendation.
